title: Superb Service
content: While waiting in surgery 3 names called for appointments but the patients were not there,so those that complain about the difficulties of booking appointments need to take this into consideration before blaming the hard working reception staff!The doctors and staff here provide a Superb Service in such difficult circumstances, when you take into account the current situation within the NHS they all deserve medals,and our sincere thanks.
real_data_note: Verbatim real patient review (4-5 star), used as a positive practice exemplar for retrieval grounding. Not an authored policy document.
